description: AI automation and agent platform for building, governing, and deploying collaborative agents across models, integrations, and business workflows.

evidence.finding: Gumloop gives organization administrators granular control over workspaces, flows, user permissions, agent tools, AI model access, and spend policies.
Gumloop's privacy policy gives users rights to request deletion of personal data and lets administrators remove users and revoke access to workspaces, flows, and credentials.
Gumloop documents organization-wide audit logging, tool-call tracing, usage monitoring, and dashboards intended to show how agents use company data and which actions they take.
Gumloop's human-in-the-loop controls can force an agent to pause before selected actions and require explicit human approval or rejection before continuing.
Gumloop offers a free tier and publishes pricing intended to make it possible for users to test automations before scaling into paid usage.
Gumloop's terms state that users retain their rights to content they submit, while its privacy policy provides access, deletion, restriction, objection, and portability rights.
Gumloop's privacy policy states that uploaded data, flows, and agent chats from premium users are not used to train AI, but the public language is specifically scoped to premium users.
Gumloop supports its own MCP server, broad external connectors, bring-your-own API keys, and data exports, giving customers multiple integration and exit paths.
Gumloop publishes a pricing model that passes through token and compute costs and adds an explicit orchestration fee, making the platform's margin structure visible.
Gumloop describes agents as collaborative assets that teams can co-own, run, improve, and use together across Slack, Teams, email, and shared workflows.
Gumloop explicitly supports human approval for customer-facing, irreversible, financial, and other consequential agent actions rather than requiring unrestricted autonomous execution.
Gumloop states that people should be able to build agents by describing a task in plain language, offers a free tier, and provides templates and self-paced learning resources.

limitations: This preliminary audit uses public Gumloop primary-source documentation and has not been reviewed by Gumloop.
Published product documentation is evidence of documented controls and policies, not proof of real-world outcomes for every deployment.
Humanity Score is a product-impact rating, not a regulatory, legal, safety, compliance, or government certification.
correction_policy: Source-backed factual corrections are welcome. Corrections change the audit only when the underlying evidence changes; payment cannot buy a higher score.
